interface.name: athanor_pip_manager_v1
interface.description: This protocol allows media players, video conferencing apps, and floating widgets to request picture-in-picture (PiP) surface enclaves with always-on-top ordering, screen corner docking, aspect-ratio constraints, and glassmorphism styling.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a PiP handle

entry.name: invalid_dimensions
entry.summary: requested PiP size out of allowed bounds

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the compositor that the client will no longer request PiP surfaces.

request.name: get_pip_surface
request.description: Instantiates a PiP interface bound to an existing wl_surface.

interface.name: athanor_pip_surface_v1
interface.description: Interface for configuring corner docking, floating geometry, opacity, aspect-ratio, and interactive overlay controls of a Picture-in-Picture window.

entry.name: always_on_top
entry.summary: keep window above standard tiled surfaces

entry.name: sticky_workspaces
entry.summary: persist visible across all workspace switches

entry.name: snap_to_corners
entry.summary: auto-magnetize to nearest screen corner on drag release

entry.name: enable_kawase_blur
entry.summary: apply dual-pass Kawase blur to PiP surface backdrop

request.name: destroy
request.description: Restores the associated surface to standard layout and frees resources.

request.name: set_corner_dock

description.summary: dock PiP window to a screen corner

request.description: Docks the PiP surface to one of the specified corners with standard screen edge margins.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: set desired dimensions for PiP surface

request.description: Sets width and height of the PiP viewport.

request.name: set_aspect_ratio
request.description: Constrains window resizing to the specified width-to-height aspect ratio.

request.name: set_flags
request.description: Sets behavioral bitmask flags such as always_on_top or backdrop blur.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Controls window opacity (0 = transparent, 255 = fully opaque).

event.name: state_changed

description.summary: notify client of updated PiP geometry and status

event.description: Emitted when PiP window position, corner dock, or dimensions change.

event.name: dismissed

description.summary: notify client that user dismissed PiP overlay

event.description: Emitted when user closes or swipes away the PiP overlay.
